messages:
IncidentBot: 🚨 SEV2 alert: routing-lb-edge p99 spike detected in us-west-2 — tail latency 2.8s (SLO breach). auto-escalate to #incidents. incident id: I-20260314-77
Maria Chen: paging oncall, I'm seeing a big p99 jump across streaming endpoints. p95 up ~400ms, p99 up ~2.8s.
Ajay (aj): I can take first look — oncall-sre, can you confirm paging?
oncall-sre: I'm on it. pulling metrics now. noticed high queuing in router instances in us-west-2, connection retransmits increasing.
Tim O'Neill: also seeing elevated tail on streaming sessions (session stall at append stage). Could be misrouting to overloaded shards.
Lucy Park: customer reports intermittent partial responses for long polls. CS reports 3 customers affected (large throughput customers).
Support Alex: adding customer IDs to incident timeline: cust-omega, cust-mont, cust-beta. they saw increased TTFB and occasional 502s.
Maria Chen: timeline: spike started ~1798004200, ramped at 1798004300, alerted at 1798004321.
Ajay (aj): checking router routing table diffs. running: `rbctl router status --zone usw2 --summary`
Ajay (aj): output snippet:
```
router-12: active connections 4200, avg latency 140ms, 99th 2.7s
router-07: active connections 120, avg latency 30ms, 99th 55ms
hash-partition: imbalance detected for shard-451
routing-policy: edge-weight overrides recently rolled 2h ago
```
Lucy Park: shard-451 hot-shard? we have hotkey mitigation for that shard normally.
Tim O'Neill: looks like traffic was routed to a subset of routers that don't have the prefix cache warmed (cold kv cache) — causing heavy kv miss cost.
IncidentBot: note: config-rollout edge-weight-overrides applied 1798001200 by deploy-bot.
Ajay (aj): rolling back weight overrides for us-west-2 now to redistribute traffic -> `rbctl policy rollback edge-weight-overrides --zone usw2`
Deploy-Bot: rollback started by Ajay (aj) at 1798004470.
oncall-sre: temporary mitigation — add eager fallback to next-lowest-latency pool for streaming routes. applying routing policy patch.
Maria Chen: enabling emergency fallback and increasing router pool capacity in usw2 (scale +3) — please coordinate.
Tim O'Neill: I've blackholed shard-451 hot key prefix on the misbehaving router-12 to stop sticky routing until redistribution completes.
Lucy Park: monitoring customers now. Support Alex, please notify cust-omega and cust-mont that we're mitigating and will follow up.
Support Alex: sent short heads-up to affected customers, noted no ETA for full RCA yet.
Ajay (aj): rollback completed at 1798004550. redistributing now. metrics show p95 decreased from 400ms -> 220ms within 2 mins. p99 trending down (2.8s -> 900ms).
IncidentBot: automated alert suppressed for 5m window; but manual watch remains.
oncall-sre: however we still see periodic stalls on streaming sessions — likely due to evicted KV cache entries and some routers still serving stale LB assignments.
Tim O'Neill: started a rolling restart of router-12 to re-warm caches. command: `systemctl restart redwood-router && sleep 60 && check-caches --shard 451`
Maria Chen: oncall-sre, after restart did tail latency improve?
oncall-sre: yes, after restart router-12 p99 dropped to 120ms for local sessions. global p99 at 1798005000 is 210ms. streaming stall count dropped from 18/min -> 2/min.
Ajay (aj): long-term: we need to prevent future misrouting from weight overrides — policy validation missing zone capacity check. filing follow-up: PROJ-rt-134 (policy safety guardrails).
Lucy Park: action items for postmortem: 1) add preflight check for edge-weight overrides (capacity & cache-warmness), 2) improve hot-shard detection + proactive spreading, 3) add automated rollback when p99 > 1s for 2m.
Maria Chen: customer impact summary for PG: 3 customers saw degraded TTFB and occasional 502s for ~18 minutes. Affected routes: streaming/polling endpoints via us-west-2. No data loss.
Support Alex: customers acknowledged; asked for timeline and RCA. I'll coordinate follow-up comms.
Tim O'Neill: reopening ticket for router telemetry retention improvement — need more granular kv cache evict/rehit metrics.
IncidentBot: incident I-20260314-77 resolved at 1798005590 (mitigated). Postmortem owner: Ajay (aj).
Maria Chen: thanks team — please add detailed logs and command snippets to the postmortem doc. handover to Ajay for RCA and timeline. :thumbsup:
Ajay (aj): taking owner. will schedule postmortem and include remediation plan.
Lucy Park: adding timeline note: mitigation steps finished by 1798005560, monitoring through 1798005600.
Support Alex: I'll draft customer-facing summary after receiving the RCA.
Tim O'Neill: quick note — recommend adding a small cache pre-warm after policy changes as a short-term safety net.
Maria Chen: agreed. closing channel when postmortem link available. :white_check_mark:
